aws-access-token.title: AWS Access Key ID Detected
aws-access-token.description: An AWS Access Key ID was detected in source code or configuration.
aws-access-token.recommendation: Revoke the exposed AWS key immediately in AWS IAM, rotate credentials, and remove it from repository history using git-filter-repo or BFG Repo-Cleaner.

aws-secret-access-key.title: AWS Secret Access Key Detected
aws-secret-access-key.description: An AWS Secret Access Key was detected in source code or configuration.
aws-secret-access-key.recommendation: Revoke the exposed AWS secret key immediately in AWS IAM, rotate credentials, and store secrets using environment variables or a secrets manager.

generic-api-key.title: Generic API Key Detected
generic-api-key.description: A generic secret or API key pattern was detected in the repository.
generic-api-key.recommendation: Revoke and rotate the exposed API key immediately. Move API keys into secure environment variables or secret store.

github-pat.title: GitHub Personal Access Token Detected
github-pat.description: A GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) was exposed in source code.
github-pat.recommendation: Revoke the GitHub PAT in GitHub account settings immediately and generate a new token with minimal necessary scopes.

private-key.title: Private Key Detected
private-key.description: An unencrypted private key (RSA, SSH, PGP, etc.) was detected.
private-key.recommendation: Immediately revoke and replace the compromised private key. Remove key files from source control and store in encrypted vault.

slack-web-hook.title: Slack Incoming Webhook URL Detected
slack-web-hook.description: A Slack Webhook URL was found exposed in the codebase.
slack-web-hook.recommendation: Delete the exposed Slack webhook in Slack App configuration and create a new incoming webhook.

stripe-api-key.title: Stripe API Key Detected
stripe-api-key.description: A Stripe secret or restricted API key was detected.
stripe-api-key.recommendation: Roll the exposed Stripe API key in the Stripe Dashboard immediately to prevent unauthorized financial transactions.

jwt.title: Hardcoded JWT Token Detected
jwt.description: A JSON Web Token (JWT) was detected in source files.
jwt.recommendation: Invalidate the JWT secret/token and refrain from committing hardcoded authorization tokens.
